commands_used: answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka in Helstrom. I took a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. The Collector and the Unbound are hunting the Eye. 2. Go to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers in the Kothringi Greathouse; Hums-the-Long-Note is the marker. 3. I can talk to Hums-the-Long-Note first, then find the elder. I favour a calm approach. 4. I do not know what the Eye is, nor who the elder is by name. I could ask the Chime-Keepers.

answer 1. Hums-the-Long-Note, elder of the Chime-Keepers, knows the keystone but wants her family grave-stake raised from a chest in drowned Zul-Etha before she tells me. 2. Go to Zul-Etha (south-east of Mir-Xal quay) and raise the grave-stake from the Drowned Chest. 3. Kill the crocodiles and old bull from a roof or with arrows, calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen. As a calm character I prefer sneaking/swimming or calming. 4. I do not know exactly where Mir-Xal quay is relative to here, but travel by marker should handle it. I do not know what the keystone does.

answer 1. I got the grave-stake from the chest without fighting the crocodiles. Hums-the-Long-Note will tell me about the keystone in return. 2. Bring the stake to Hums-the-Long-Note in Toklea. 3. Just go back and hand it over. 4. Still do not know what the keystone is or does; she should tell me.

answer 1. The keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a ruin near Gideon; the captain was buried with what marked the way along the kings road to the Root. 2. Tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Go straight to her, or go to Eurydike myself first; the journal points to Nesh-Deeka. 4. I do not know what the Root is or how it relates to the Eye; Nesh-Deeka may know.

answer 1. Quest done. Hums-the-Long-Note told me the Kothringi Keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike near Gideon, after I raised her family grave-stake from drowned Zul-Etha. Nesh-Deeka knew the Unbound are asking about Eurydike, said we listen, told me to hurry, paid 100 gold. 2. Nothing is set; I should go to Eurydike near Gideon before the Unbound. 3. Go to Eurydike and open the tomb with the keystone, or ask more first. 4. I do not know what the Root is, how the Eye relates, or how she really knows things; unknown.

answer Notes: I work for Nesh-Deeka (Toh-Reel-Ka, Helstrom). The elder Hums-the-Long-Note of Toklea told me, in return for her family grave-stake (I raised it from the Zul-Etha drowned chest without fighting the crocodiles, and gave it to her), that the Kothringi Keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike, a roofless Kothringi hall just north of Gideon. The captain was buried with what marked the kings road to the Root. Nesh-Deeka knows the Unbound have been asking Gideon diggers about Eurydike; she says we listen, and told me to hurry. She paid me 100 gold, so I have about 700. I still carry the keystone, Pale Harvest strongbox key, Old Silver Setting, The Collector note, smuggler key. Next: go to Eurydike near Gideon and open the tomb before the Unbound and the Collector (Ennodius Vanin). Unknown: what the Root and the Eye really are, and how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows.
